# FLX-4104: Simulation.spec.fidelity names a value this engine does not recognise

**Family:** governance/sovereignty (the 4000 band)

The FLUX schema's fidelity enum is deterministic/stochastic/agentic; a value outside that set has no execution path in this engine and is refused rather than silently treated as deterministic (which `require_supported_fidelity` would otherwise do by only checking the two escalated values by name).

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-4104
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
